subject: Cross-jurisdiction invoice weave & cost-center routing
messages:
From: Avery Collins <avery.collins@orchidhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Orchid Health Billing <billing@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Multi-entity invoicing for Q2 purchase — routing + VAT questions

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As we get our PO in place, Procurement asked for a few specifics on how Redwood will issue invoices for our multi-entity purchase:

- We have two legal entities purchasing (Orchid Health US and Orchid Health EU) but one consolidated order.
- Can Redwood issue split invoices that route amounts to each entity with correct VAT handling for the EU portion?
- Our AP team needs: invoice lines mapped to our cost centers (CC: PROD, CC: CLINICAL), a VAT breakdown per line, and a Remit-To for each entity.

Also, our procurement prefers a single payment run (one ACH) that the remittance is then split internally. If Redwood can produce per-entity invoice PDFs with distinct remit addresses and VAT numbers, that would make our reconciliation straightforward.

Can you share an example template and confirm whether you charge any administrative pass-through or remittance surcharge for split invoices?

Appreciate it — please loop in anyone on your side who helps with multi-entity billing.

Best,
Avery Collins
Sr. Procurement Manager
Orchid Health

[Attachment: orchid_mop_spec.pdf (PDF) — short spec of Orchid invoicing requirements]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery.collins@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing for Q2 purchase — routing + VAT questions

Hi Avery — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (finance) and Ben (account exec) so we can align commercial + operations.

Short answer: yes, we can produce split invoices that show line-level allocations and remit-to details per Redwood legal entity. A few important notes up front:

1) Method options for you to choose (we can support any of these):
   - Split PDFs per legal entity: We issue separate invoice PDFs for US and EU entities with the correct VAT registration on the EU invoice. Customer receives two invoices referencing the same PO.
   - Single consolidated invoice with embedded per-entity breakdown: One PDF that contains a clear section for each Orchid entity, including VAT amounts and remit instructions.
   - Tagged lines + accounting CSV: In addition to PDFs, we can deliver a machine-readable CSV/GL export mapping invoice rows to your cost centers for ingestion.

2) Payment flow: Redwood will accept the single ACH from Orchid. We do not redistribute funds on your behalf — Redwood's invoices will indicate the amount due per entity and remit-to for each. Orchid would perform the internal split after payment. Alternatively, for customers who require, we can coordinate with a payments partner to provide payer-side split remittances (this typically adds fees from the payments processor).

3) Administrative surcharge: Redwood does not add a standard fee for issuing split invoices. If Orchid requests that we act as a pass-through remittance agent (we hold and distribute funds to multiple payees), that is a different service and would carry an implementation and monthly ops fee.

4) VAT handling: For EU invoice lines, Redwood will include VAT amounts and the EU VAT registration on the invoice. We will need to confirm which entity is selling to which Orchid legal entity (to establish reverse-charge vs. standard VAT treatment).

Next steps: I attached a "multi-entity invoice weave" template (Excel) that shows how we map lines to entities, cost centers, and VAT fields. Marissa — can you confirm whether the finance team is comfortable providing the CSV mapping spec in the same format as the template? Ben — can you confirm the PO number and whether Orchid prefers split PDFs or a consolidated doc?

Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Account Solutions | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: multi-entity-invoice-weave-template.xlsx (XLSX) — example mapping & line-level columns]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: routing approach and carve-outs for Orchid Health (finance review)

Folks — quick internal note after reviewing the template and Orchid's spec:

- Template looks good; CSV column set matches what AR can ingest: invoice_id, line_id, description, qty, unit_price, total, entity_code, cost_center_code, vat_rate, vat_amount, remit_to_entity, external_reference.
- We need confirmation of entity mapping: do they want Redwood US (RG_US_001) for subscription and Redwood EU (RG_EU_002) for EU-facing services? Ben, can you confirm their legal entity mapping with procurement?
- VAT treatment: Assuming Orchid EU is VAT-registered, we will need their VAT numbers per remit entity. Kimberly, please request their EU VAT ID and whether reverse-charge applies.
- Remittance handling: We do NOT perform payment splits. If they want us to hold and disburse, we need legal sign-off and a new SOW for payments facilitation. That's a non-standard ops activity and will take ~4 weeks to enable.

Action items:
  - Ben: Confirm PO and entity pairing with Avery (today).
  - Kimberly: Request VAT IDs + preferred remit addresses (today).
  - Michael: Offer choice of split PDFs vs consolidated PDF to Avery and flag the payments facilitation caveat.

Marissa
